newsitem.title: USA: AMCOL backs Q4 estimate of $0.23-0.24/shr.
newsitem.headline: AMCOL backs Q4 estimate of $0.23-0.24/shr.

text.p: AMCOL International Corp backs analysts' earnings estimates of $0.23 to $0.24 a share for the fourth quarter ended December 31, 1996, said AMCOL President John Hughes.
The specialty chemical and mineral company, reported 1995 fourth quarter earnings of $0.23 a share.

Strong performance by AMCOL's absorbent polymers and environmental segments drove the earnings, Hughes told a meeting of analysts and institutional investors late Monday in New York, according to a company statement.
He said the company's minerals segment, which had experienced lower margins and income earlier in the year largely related to the start-up of three new cat litter operations, continued to rebound.

The company's Chemdal polymer operations recorded strong sales for October and November, he said. The environmental segment has done well in the face of a customary seasonality that can affect performance this time of year, he added.
In addition, he said results benefitted from a cost-cutting program put in place for the minerals segment earlier this year and sales in the metalcasting and cat litter markets have remained strong.
